name: A successful Aneurysm interrupt heals the Bloodmage for 5% of maximum health (#3713)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Aneurysm 806099 DurationIndex 35 (4000 ms school lockout), RecoveryTime 24000, Mechanic 26 (MECHANIC_INTERRUPT), RangeIndex 4 (30 yds), PowerType -2 with ManaCostPercentage 10, and a single effect 68 (SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST) with TargetA 6. Its tooltip adds 'Successfully interrupting an enemy heals you for $520860s1% of your maximum health'. 520860 exists as a single SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT of 5% on the caster and nothing in the source or the world DB ever cast it, while Spell::EffectInterruptCast already raises OnSpellSuccessfulInterrupt only when an interrupt actually landed. Fixture: Scholomance Dark Summoner 11582 runs SmartAI with an in-combat event that casts Summon Risen Lackey 17618 on itself (4000 ms cast, PreventionType SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_SILENCE, InterruptFlags 0x9) 2-5 sec after engaging and again every 5-7 sec. Self-targeted is required because harness creatures are forced REACT_PASSIVE (CoAGameplayTest.cpp), so they never acquire a victim and SmartAI actions aimed at one never resolve; the same passivity means the fixture never strikes back, so no melee noise reaches the measurement. QA Test +10000 HP/MP 10040 at 20 stacks raises maximum health by about 200000 without touching create health, so Aneurysm's own cost (10% of create health, a few hundred) is negligible against the 5% heal, and health is then set to 50000 so the heal is not clipped by the cap. The contract is therefore a clearly positive health-percentage step across the interrupt, where the unhealed behaviour can only lose the cast's own health cost. The opening wait is 26000 ms rather than a short settle because the same creature also runs an out-of-combat SmartAI event (smart_scripts entry 11582 id 0, SMART_EVENT_UPDATE_OOC, initial 1000-20000 ms) casting Summon Frail Skeleton 16531 on itself, a 5000 ms cast whose PreventionType is SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_NONE and which Spell::EffectInterruptCast therefore never interrupts, while the harness's casting metric is Unit::IsNonMeleeSpellCast(false) and cannot tell the two casts apart. 20000 + 5000 bounds that cast, so 26000 ms clears it, and SmartScript::UpdateTimer freezes the out-of-combat timer while the creature is engaged, so it cannot recur once the attack lands; the only cast the mid-cast gate can then catch is Summon Risen Lackey 17618. timeout_ms is 120000 to cover the wait.

steps.label: Let the out-of-combat Summon Frail Skeleton cast finish
Health percentage just before the interrupt

The interrupt heals the Bloodmage for 5% of maximum health
